title: MZ Free RPG Maker MZ utility Plugin – side-view battler positioning for custom resolutions

posts.author: CynthiaTools
posts.body:
Hi everyone, I'm sharing a small free utility plugin for RPG Maker MZ.
This plugin allows you to manually adjust side-view actor battler positions when using different screen resolutions (e.g. 1280×720, 1920×1080).
It applies a final, engine-safe offset after RPG Maker finishes its normal battle positioning, without touching formation logic or battle scenes.
Side-view only
Resolution-based X / Y offsets
Simple and predictable behavior
Free to use (commercial & non-commercial)
Posting in case it’s useful to anyone working with custom resolutions.
you can download it here:
CT_BattleResolutionFix

posts.body:
Patch Notes
Bug Fixes
-Fixed an issue where side-view battler positions could sometimes reset after closing and reopening the game when using a 1280x720 screen resolution.
-Improved position persistence so custom battler placement remains more stable across game sessions.
-Added additional handling for resolution-based battler positioning to prevent unexpected layout resets after relaunching the game.
